h1: Supercharge Namibian enterprise with autonomous AI agents
sub: Equip your business with autonomous cloud bots that research, write code, and coordinate tasks 24/7—even when your phone is offline.
audience: Safari operators, logistics managers in Walvis Bay, commercial farmers, mining consultants, and Windhoek digital entrepreneurs.
manifesto: From Windhoek boardroom meetings to vast cattle ranches and coastal freight hubs, Ceyo runs tireless cloud computers that handle research, outreach, and multi-app tasks, ensuring your operations never stop when network signals fade.

uses.d: Deploy an autonomous browser agent that checks tour aggregator rates, updates availability across portals, and replies instantly to European travelers across time zones.
Assign bots to monitor port vessel schedules, pull clearance status from customs websites, and push consolidated freight updates straight into Slack or Google Sheets.
Set scheduled daily routines to scour auction prices for livestock across Otjozondjupa and Omaheke, compiling clear market reports while you manage the ranch.
Let your bot run deep research across government gazettes and ministry portals, summarizing regulatory updates and environmental compliance requirements into Notion.
Use the coding agent to build, test, and host client dashboards and web utilities directly inside its secure cloud environment without draining your laptop battery.
Automate supplier price comparisons across Namibian and South African hardware vendors, keeping currency conversions and quotes organized in a shared workspace.

steps.d: Select the specialist role your business requires and launch its isolated 24/7 cloud computer in seconds.
Link Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, or your CRM so your agent can interact with your daily business channels.
Assign workflows, scheduled routines, or phone tasks, and let your bots execute autonomously around the clock.

chapters.d: While you drive past Independence Avenue, your Ceyo Telegram bot delivers a synthesized breakdown of overnight overseas booking inquiries and urgent client emails. Its cloud computer worked through the night, ranking priority leads.

Your logistics bot autonomously visits maritime tracking portals to verify container discharge times at Walvis Bay harbor. It updates a live spreadsheet and pings your warehouse manager without manual intervention.

Out on a remote farm with intermittent cellular coverage, you send a quick voice message via Telegram. The bot parses your instructions, computes livestock feed ratios, and schedules next week's supplier orders.
You switch off your laptop and head to rest. In the cloud, your coding bot continues testing a new company booking portal while another agent prepares competitive market intelligence for tomorrow.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Namibia and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is only charged once the trial completes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots continue running if my phone or computer is switched off?
faq.a: Yes. Every Ceyo bot runs inside its own isolated cloud computer that operates 24/7 independently of your local hardware, making it ideal for maintaining business continuity even during local power or network outages.

faq.q: Which languages can my Ceyo agents understand and write?
faq.a: Ceyo agents natively communicate in English, Afrikaans, German, and dozens of other international languages, allowing you to converse naturally and engage overseas tourists and partners with ease.

faq.q: How do I interact with my bots through Telegram?
faq.a: You can chat directly with your personal Ceyo bot on Telegram or add multiple specialist bots into a Telegram group where they collaborate together as a unified digital team.

faq.q: Can Ceyo connect to my existing business applications?
faq.a: Yes. Ceyo connects seamlessly with over 1,000 popular business applications including Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Notion, calendars, and CRM platforms.
